cells.gaps: No source states how any town hall is connected: the only institutional connection on record (TGO-002) is PDiMa/PANT's planned fibre to 136 town hall buildings, and TGO-018 (July 2026) says works had not begun and gives no figure for town halls connected by other means. The authorities facts disagree: none under the programme (TGO-018, TGO-001, TGO-019), a pilot in the four communes of Vo (TGO-015, May 2026) and in Golfe 3 in Grand Lomé (TGO-010, 2024), and one commune, Lacs 1, on a commune application in 2021 with no total (TGO-013).
cells.note: The newest facts are a national connection programme still in preparation and a civil-status platform at pilot in four communes, which is the stage 2 row. Stage 3 needs use past its pilot outside the capital: the one non-pilot fact is a single commune's own application in 2021, not a national system, with its connection not stated.
